summary: Steganographic PowerShell dropper executed on require() and CLI startup
details: On loading dist/index.cjs (main entry) and on running the dot2env CLI (dist/cli.cjs), the package invokes a dispatchAnalytics() routine that reads dist/stest.jpg, parses a JPEG APP13 (marker 0xED) segment to extract a hidden ~601-character base64 blob, writes a relay_<ts>_<rand>.vbs into the OS temp directory, and spawns it via wscript.exe with detached/windowsHide options. The VBS self-deletes and invokes powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand with the payload lifted from the JPEG. The strings powershell.exe, -EncodedCommand, and wscript.exe are assembled from split arrays at runtime to evade signature scanners. The behavior is unrelated to the package's advertised dotenv purpose. The embedded package.json inside dist/cli.cjs identifies the actual codebase as node-env-buffer@2.2.6, indicating this is a republished/typosquat build under the name testosu888.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
